headline: Healthy Q2; Order prospects remain strong

highlights: Change in Estimates Current Previous FY28E FY29E FY28E FY29E Rating Accumulate Accumulate Target Price 1,554 1,472 Sales (INR mn) 317,996 366,604 312,123 360,621 % Chng. 1.9 1.7 EBITDA (INR mn) 28,779 33,911 29,183 34,079 % Chng.

YTD order inflows surged ~60% YoY to ~INR240bn, with an additional ~INR50bn of projects where the company is favorably placed, prompting management to upgrade FY27 order inflow guidance to INR350-360bn from INR300bn.
The order book stood at a INR718.5bn, providing healthy growth visibility, while FY27 revenue growth guidance of ~15% was reiterated.
T&D, B&F and Oil & Gas remain key growth engines, supported by a robust transmission pipeline, strong traction in residential and industrial EPC, and international gas infrastructure opportunities.
